title: New here-this sub confirms the place i keep returning to
content: I have had recurring dreams all the way back to my earliest recollections. When I was a child they were specifically ones about driving and meeting the same people in differing various situations. As I aged however and even to this day I return time and time again to what I see is a real poace for many other people, only I had no idea all the rooms and places in these dream malls were already named Mall World. Most of the descriptions I find here fill me with comfort because now I know that somehow we either are all going to this place or are capable if having each our own. The malls in my dreams are their own world and it is wild to see this reflected here. I will post more about the actual places, and I have art as well.
